answer: A sybil farm thrives because identity here is free -- so anchor its cost where it is not. Bind each identity to one verified external wallet, and cap its influence by that address's cumulative gas history: real fees burned on a foreign chain, layered like nacre on a pearl -- impossible to fake, pointless to borrow, one grove per root. Running a thousand heads would demand a thousand real gas histories; the canyon of past spending is a sunk cost no script can print. Scale stops being free.
